ELESIS-ELESIS_SPECIALIZATION_EVENT.title: Elesis' Specialization
ELESIS-ELESIS_SPECIALIZATION_EVENT.pages:
The Belder Knight Emblem burns with stored experience.

[center][img width=110 height=122]res://Elesis/images/specializations/saber_knight.png[/img] [img width=110 height=122]res://Elesis/images/specializations/pyro_knight.png[/img] [img width=110 height=122]res://Elesis/images/specializations/dark_knight.png[/img] [img width=110 height=122]res://Elesis/images/specializations/soar_knight.png[/img][/center]

Choose Elesis' specialization for the rest of this run.

Free.
Elesis becomes Saber Knight.
Whenever Elesis gains [blue]Chivalry[/blue], gain 1 additional [blue]Chivalry[/blue].

Free.
Elesis becomes Pyro Knight.
Whenever Elesis gains [color=#ff8a1f]Flame[/color], gain 1 additional [color=#ff8a1f]Flame[/color].

Free.
Elesis becomes Dark Knight.
Elesis' attacks deal 1 additional damage.

Free.
Elesis becomes Soar Knight.
Whenever Elesis gains [gold]Block[/gold], gain 1 additional [gold]Block[/gold].

Elesis accepts her new path.
The emblem changes shape, and her combat style follows.
